findings.lineage: The D-353/D-354 successor sweep is internally contradictory and under-swept.
findings.finding: The candidate's purpose, basedOn.leftoverJoinV32, basedOn.fixtureCorpusV30, remeasurementClause, top-level head, and structured recordedInputs carry the adopted D-353/D-354 state, but several live leaves still carry the D-351/D-352 state. registerRowNote says v33 remasures after g21-fixture-corpus.v26/D-352 rather than v30/D-354. authorityClaim says v33 remasures leftover-join.v28 to HEAD ef219c... and last heading D-352 after corpus v26, even though live HEAD and the candidate's top-level head are 2a6df...; v32/D-353 is the current recorded predecessor; and D-354/v30 is the new authoring act. basedOn.predecessorV28.role still labels v28 'the current G21 leftover remasurement' before naming v32 current in the same string. Four finding dispositions still describe current-remasurement recitals as v28/D-351, and findingDisposition.claudeV29M2 restates the obsolete D-352/v26 authority anchor.
findings.evidence: D-353 records frozen leftover-join.v32 of G21. D-354 then records g21-fixture-corpus.v30's four per-D-002-platform copies and expressly leaves v32 as the D-353 current recorded G21 leftover remasurement. Live HEAD is 2a6df439402ce686963447482a4e5150e4d8cd32 and live COORD's last heading is D-354. Within v33, purpose and remeasurementClause agree with those facts. The v32-to-v33 leaf delta nevertheless leaves present-tense v28/D-351 and v26/D-352 recitals in the listed fields. It also removes obligations[3].remainingNotAuthored.cc5TruncatedBodyCopies and adds authoredImplementations.cc5TruncatedBodyCopies, while findingDisposition.claudeV29M3 falsely says the copy remainder still remains in registerRowNote, leftoverDesignOpenStanding, and obligations[3].remainingNotAuthored.cc5TruncatedBodyCopies.
findings.why: A leftover remasurement successor must identify the frozen recorded predecessor and the authoring event whose remainder it remasures. These are operative custody facts, not harmless history. The obsolete authority sentence, v28-current recitals, and stale copy-remainder disposition contradict the candidate's own correct D-353/D-354 fields and trigger the prompt's attacks on v28 currency and on treating the four D-354 copies as still unauthored.
findings.requiredCorrection: Make registerRowNote and authorityClaim identify leftover-join.v32 of G21/D-353 as the current recorded predecessor, live HEAD 2a6df439402ce686963447482a4e5150e4d8cd32, and g21-fixture-corpus.v30/D-354 as the authoring act after which v33 remasures the four copies stale. Distinguish v28's historical D-351 recording from present currency. Update every listed present-tense finding disposition to the D-353/D-354 state and to the authored/stale status of the four copies. Preserve all frozen Findings-land destinations and do not remasure v32 or either fixture corpus as a golden.

findings.finding: Four present-tense disposition leaves conflict with the candidate's correct D-354 custody. findingDisposition.claudeV21M3 says the basedOn historical roles retain D-352 custody even though all 22 non-D-354 structured commit roles say custody remains D-354. findingDisposition.claudeV26M3 says findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody names basedOn.d352.role as sole claimant, but that sibling actually names basedOn.d354.role and basedOn.d352.role expressly says it is not last-heading. findingDisposition.codexV27MustFix says claudeV21M3 advances to D-352, while findingDisposition.codexV30MustFix says the live recitals advance to D-352/basedOn.d352.role.
findings.evidence: Live COORD's final heading is D-354. basedOn.d354.role is the sole positive structured last-live claimant. The other 22 decision commit roles say Last-heading custody remains D-354, with zero retaining D-352 custody. purpose and findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody also name basedOn.d354.role. The four cited disposition leaves are therefore false descriptions of sibling fields in this v33 object, not merely frozen quotations.
findings.why: The prompt requires basedOn.d354.role to be the sole last-heading claimant and specifically attacks basedOn.d352.role being named sole. Dispositions that assert earlier MUST-FIX repairs landed cannot contradict the fields they purport to describe or revive a competing D-352 claimant.
findings.requiredCorrection: Advance the four live finding-disposition recitals to D-354/basedOn.d354.role while preserving the historical finding labels, identifierInvented false, and all frozen Findings-land destinations.

reviewSummary: REJECT at 3 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject identity, mode, strict JSON validity, duplicate-key freedom, all 173 recorded-input files plus recordedInputs.HEAD, all 151 structured path/digest pairs, and all 23 decision commit pins reproduce. Live HEAD, file 08, required-now 28, D-354 final-heading custody in the structured basedOn roles, frozen v32/D-353 currency, and the D-354 authored copies all reproduce. Rejection is semantic and narrative-integrity based: authorityClaim/registerRowNote and several dispositions remain anchored to the D-351/D-352 state; four last-heading dispositions still assert D-352 custody; and three narrative fields cite the obsolete pre-D-353/D-354 COORD digest. OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING otherwise remains the sole leftover-design obligation, the closed-if-accepted list is empty, prefix exactly at the operative bound remains open, protected rows are not SATISFIED, and frozen Findings-land destinations remain intact.
